credit: Photo: Toro (product image via toro.com), used here for internal parts reference.

model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's studio photo and are approximate. The photo shows the current Pro Force with a Kohler EFI engine; Blower 1 and 2 are 2018 model 44552 with the carburetted Kohler CH740, so the engine, air cleaner and fuel parts look different on the machines. The battery, muffler, fuel tank, drive shaft, nozzle belt and turbine sit inside or behind and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3400-246 and operator's manual 3410-165 (s/n 316000001 and up); read the serial plate, as s/n 403070001 and up uses catalog 3423-905.

frame.name: Frame and hitch tongue
frame.desc: Tow-behind frame carrying the engine, turbine and nozzle (Frame, Wheel, Axle and Hitch Assembly page of catalog 3400-246). No grease points are listed in the service schedule.

hitch.name: Hitch clevis
hitch.desc: Clevis hitch at the end of the tongue for towing behind a utility vehicle. Shown on the Frame, Wheel, Axle and Hitch Assembly page.

engine.name: Engine: Kohler CH740 V-twin
engine.desc: Kohler CH740-3331 Command PRO V-twin, two spark plugs (the photo shows the later EFI engine). Daily: oil level, clean the engine screen and oil cooler, look over wiring and battery cables near the engine and muffler. Oil 2.0 L with filter, detergent oil API SG, SH, SJ or higher, viscosity per the manual chart. Change oil every 100 h; oil filter 108-3847 every 200 h. Bulletin 04-08: if the engine stops after about 3 minutes and restarts, the TEC controller is cutting fuel because it gets no oil-pressure signal. Test the Kohler oil pressure switch (open with the engine off, closed to ground with it running); kit 24 755 425-S with a new boot. Kohler engine parts come through a Kohler dealer.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: 108-3847, every 200 h (oil alone every 100 h). Not shown in the later catalog 3423-905: check with the dealer if the serial is 403070001 or above.

plugs.name: Spark plugs (x2)
plugs.desc: Champion RC12YC (or Champion Platinum 3071), gap 0.76 mm. Check every 200 h.

presswitch.name: Oil pressure switch
presswitch.desc: Bulletin 04-08 fix for the engine shutting down after about 3 minutes: test the switch (open engine off, closed to ground engine running) and fit kit 24 755 425-S with a new boot.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Foam pre-filter: clean every 25 h, more often in dust or sand, and check the paper element for damage. Paper element: replace every 100 h. Toro's documents give no Kohler numbers; the old Notion list had 24 083 03-S and 24 083 05-S, which are not confirmed for spec CH740-3331: confirm with a Kohler dealer.

fuel.name: Fuel filter
fuel.desc: Replace fuel filter 120-2235 every 500 h. The photo shows the later EFI engine: check the filter fitted on Blower 1 and 2 before ordering.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank
fueltank.desc: 18.9 L of unleaded petrol (Engine, Muffler and Fuel Tank Assembly page).

canister.name: Carbon canister and purge-line filter
canister.desc: Every 200 h: replace the carbon-canister air filter (not listed separately; canister 127-8685, ask the dealer) and the purge-line filter 115-7854, fitted with the arrow toward the vacuum check valve 115-7868.

intake.name: Turbine intake guard
intake.desc: Finned guard on the turbine side of the housing. Keep it clear of leaves and debris.

turbine.name: Turbine housing and turbine
turbine.desc: Turbine assembly 125-4260 in the red housing, running on two ball bearings 112-6764 (toro.com US list USD 65.24 each). Driven from the engine through drive shaft 115-5124-03 with four rubber couplings 115-5129.

driveshaft.name: Drive shaft and rubber couplings
driveshaft.desc: Engine-to-turbine drive shaft 115-5124-03 with four rubber couplings 115-5129. There are no U-joints and nothing to grease (the old Notion 'grease U-joint weekly' row is wrong). There is no PTO clutch in catalog 3400-246.

nozzledrive.name: Nozzle drive
nozzledrive.desc: Reversible nozzle rotation motor 130-8551 turns the nozzle through V-belt 112-1853 (56.15 in., about 1426 mm). Check belt condition and tension at the first 8 h, then every 50 h. Keep a spare belt. Nozzle guides x4 (114-9868): check daily.

belt.name: Nozzle drive V-belt
belt.desc: 112-1853, 56.15 in. (about 1426 mm). Check condition and tension at the first 8 h, then every 50 h. Keep one spare.

nozzle.name: Nozzle
nozzle.desc: Rotating nozzle 119-6287. Optional tapered nozzle kit 119-6280 or rectangular nozzle kit 119-6281. Daily: check the nozzle clamp and the four nozzle guides 114-9868.

fender.name: Fender
fender.desc: Wheel fender over the tyre (Frame, Wheel, Axle and Hitch Assembly page).

tyre.name: Tyre and wheel
tyre.desc: Tyre 99-4506 on wheel assembly 98-8691 at 96.5 kPa (14 psi); check pressure daily and tyre condition every 100 h. Torque the wheel lug nuts to 95-122 N.m at the first 10 h. Hub and bearing assembly 117-5115 (cup 254-72, cone 254-94, seal 112-1690; the cups and cones are standard tapered bearings).

hubs.name: Hub and bearings
hubs.desc: Hub and bearing assembly 117-5115: cup 254-72, cone 254-94, seal 112-1690.

control.name: Control box and remote
control.desc: Engine and nozzle controls with the TEC controller and wireless remote receiver. Remote assembly 125-1270 (the old Notion number 127-2701 was not found). Fault finding uses electrical schematic 3395-527. Ignition coil, starter, governor actuator and RF receiver numbers are not verified.

harness.name: Wiring harness
harness.desc: Main harness 122-0220 with a Bussmann fuse block. Daily: look over wiring and battery cables near the engine and muffler. Open fault on Blower 2 (WO 1494): dead battery and smoking wire, treat as a fire risk. Disconnect the battery (negative first) and tag out, trace the smoking circuit against schematic 3395-527, check for chafe or contact near the muffler and engine, then check charging before refitting the battery.

battery.name: 12 V battery
battery.desc: Toro 106-5187 (106-8397 is a different Toro wet battery). Battery cables 125-5966 negative and 122-0629 positive. Blower 2 (WO 1494): battery disconnected and tagged out until the smoking-wire fault is fixed.

muffler.name: Muffler
muffler.desc: On the Engine, Muffler and Fuel Tank Assembly page. Keep wiring and battery cables clear of the muffler (Blower 2 fault).

Champion 3071.name: Spark plug, Champion Platinum 3071
Champion 3071.note: Alternative to Champion RC12YC per the operator's manual. Gap 0.76 mm.

24 083 03-S.name: Kohler air element (unconfirmed)
24 083 03-S.note: From the old Notion list. Not confirmed for CH740-3331: check with a Kohler dealer.

24 083 05-S.name: Kohler foam pre-cleaner (unconfirmed)
24 083 05-S.note: From the old Notion list. Not confirmed for CH740-3331: check with a Kohler dealer.

127-8685.name: Carbon canister
127-8685.note: Fuel delivery page. Its air filter is not listed separately: ask the dealer.

115-7868.name: Vacuum check valve
115-7868.note: Fit the purge-line filter 115-7854 with the arrow toward this valve.

254-72.name: Bearing cup
254-72.note: Part of hub and bearing assembly 117-5115.

254-94.name: Bearing cone
254-94.note: Part of hub and bearing assembly 117-5115.

112-1690.name: Hub seal
112-1690.note: Part of hub and bearing assembly 117-5115.

122-0220.name: Main wiring harness
122-0220.note: Schematic 3395-527. Check for chafe near the muffler (Blower 2 fault).

108-3847: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)
115-5129 / 115-5124-03: Drive shaft rubber couplings (x4) / drive shaft
117-5115: Toro dealer (cups/cones are standard tapered bearings)
